jobs.description:
Love sports? Want to change the world? Prime Video is re-inventing the live sports experience by merging high-quality live streaming, immersive interactive features, and exclusive access to some of the world's most loved sports properties - including the NFL, NBA, English Premier League and UEFA Champions League soccer, Rolland-Garros (French Open), the US Open and more. Every day we face the challenges of a fast-paced market and expanding technology set. And we're building at a scale only Amazon is capable of. The Prime Video Sports team is a single-threaded-owner, uniquely positioned to execute our vision across the entire Prime Video stack to deliver the most compelling new experiences to our customers. If this sounds like the type of experience you'd like to help build - apply here and let's chat!

Who we are:
We are deeply connected with the idea that live sports events are fundamentally different: there is only one shot at delivering the moment until it is forever lost. Our mission is to make sure that our customers never miss a single moment of the sports they love. To do this we need to deliver best-in-class live sports infrastructure, testing, monitoring, and operations to optimize the delivery of live sports experiences at scale. Our team engineers for speed, quality, availability, and scale. As Prime Video has grown, we've increased the depth and breadth of video products we support, with a corresponding increase in the associated size and complexity of our engineering activity and the load on our services. Our goal is to adapt our architecture to maintain and improve our velocity of delivery for customers in the face of these changes, and for our services to be on and error-free 24/7, especially for high-profile, exclusive content. With AI as a transformative force, we're at an inflection point that enables us to unlock new opportunities in predictive analytics, automated defect analysis and mitigation, and automated operations that were previously beyond our reach.

What we're looking for:
We need a highly talented Senior Technical Program Manager to build resilient, highly available, and operationally excellent systems that power our vision. You'll anticipate availability risks, manage critical incidents and escalations, and balance business SLA commitments against technical constraints and operational trade-offs.

You must break down complex reliability initiatives into manageable operational improvements, develop comprehensive availability specifications, and deliver measurable enhancements to system uptime and operational health. We seek someone with a strong curiosity to build and nurture an operationally mature, reliability-focused engineering culture—fostering proactive monitoring practices, blameless post-mortem disciplines, and integrating emerging observability and chaos engineering technologies into our operational excellence framework.

What you will do here:
You will own and drive product features partnering with SDMs in our Seattle,WA Austin, TX and Arlington, VA teams. You'll collaborate with Prime Video teams including Catalog, Commerce, Offers, X-Ray, Prime Video Channels, Store Front Automation, devices and more. You will look around corners, anticipate bottlenecks, and use technical judgement to land complex programs for our business. You will also influence and shape how we execute and help drive velocity with high quality. You will manage complex, high-impact availability and operational excellence initiatives spanning multiple teams. Balance competing priorities while maintaining focus on system reliability, operational health, and measurable availability outcomes.

You will transform operational incidents, availability gaps, and reliability concerns into prioritized technical specifications by partnering with engineering and operations teams to identify high-impact reliability requirements. Help teams distinguish between tactical incident fixes and strategic availability solutions, consolidating related operational needs into cohesive reliability improvement projects with clear business value and customer impact.

This role involves regular communication with senior, director, and VP level management on project status and risks, broad cross-team coordination on project execution, creating effective project management strategies to meet deliverables and organize teams, and regular updates to Critical Program Reviews and other reporting mechanisms.

If you’re excited about helping to build the future of live sports or just want to have fun creating something you can be proud to show your family and friends, reach out. We’d love to chat.

What you will get from us:
A great team to work with and the chance to build a top tier services at a proven top tier company. You will get a startup like culture with the stability of an established industry leader. You will get support and resources from some of the smartest people in the industry to continue learning.

Key job responsibilities
• Define, design, and implement multi-tier distributed services and customer experiences
• Be involved in designing, implementing, and testing of major features
• Estimate engineering effort, plan implementation, and rollout system changes that meet requirements for functionality, performance, scalability, reliability, and adherence to development goals and principles.
• Effectively collaborate in a fast-paced environment with multiple teams in large organization (software development, QA, Project/Release Management, Build and Release, etc).

A day in the life
- Interact with leaders from product and/or other partner tech teams and stakeholders for conceptualizing, scoping and/or planning delivery.
- Assist with project planning, task break-down, delivery and track status with your team
- Communicate delivery status to stakeholders
- Contribute to the vision, goals, and technical strategy in alignment with customer needs and market opportunities.
- Provide leadership on complex technical issues, design trade-offs, and feature and schedule prioritization.
- Innovate on behalf of customer

About the team
- We are a team who value diversity, respect, and inclusiveness. We love mentoring and helping each other grow.
- Our technology choices and designs are driven from the engineers, not handed down from above.
- We have a lot of say for what goes into our product. We get to pitch our ideas up the chain, not the other way around.

jobs.description:
Prime Video Sports is revolutionizing how customers enjoy live sports. We are expanding the breadth of live content including Thursday Night Football, and NBA, and the depth of the sports fan experience. This is a transformative opportunity, a chance to be in the vanguard of a program that will revolutionize Prime Video and the live streaming experience of customers everywhere. We emphasize work-life harmony and a fun work environment as we deliver delight to sports fans.

We seek an experienced and motivated technical program management leader to deliver critical programs delighting Prime Video Sports fans. In this role you will be responsible for managing complex projects in Sports Data Platform, Partner Integrations, and Customer Outreach platforms, tracking dependencies, and launching features collaborating with our internal stakeholders and teams.

You will work across organizational boundaries to build relationships, influence partner team roadmaps, track multiple programs, bring visibility to stakeholders, and deliver results to customers. You are comfortable dealing with technically complex, and ambiguous projects. You will participate in technical discussions, discuss trade-offs, and partner with the Engineering Managers to come up with a delivery plan. If you enjoy operating in a startup-like environment, working very closely across product, tech, science and marketing, to launch and scale products that have the potential to be game changers - this could be the perfect role for you.


Key job responsibilities
- Own and deliver high-visibility programs across Customer Conversions, Partner Integrations, and Sports Data Platform teams
- Create mechanisms to track programs, report progress, unblock software development teams, and execute on goals
- Manage partner team relationships, influence their roadmap and priorities to deliver dependent components for PV Sports
- Understand high-level technical architecture, and participate in technical discussions with the team
- Work closely with the software engineering team to address their pain points and remove bottlenecks
- Send timely updates including monthly newsletters to leadership bringing visibility to high-profile programs
- Balance diving deep and resolving issues yourself, and escalating for help.
- Be comfortable adopting and driving AI best practices in the org


A day in the life
You are responsible for delivering complex projects with high visibility. This requires building key relationships with Engineering Managers, Leadership, Partner teams, and SDEs.

This role requires program management, project management, technical deep dive, and operational excellence skills. You should be comfortable operating at different depth - diving deep with the team as well as summarizing high-level progress for leadership. You should be comfortable working closely with people with different skills and roles.

About the team
Customer Conversions team is responsible for converting passive customers to active sports fans. We engage them through outbound push notifications, and in-app features.

Partner Integrations is responsible for ingesting partner content and metadata into Prime Video to expand selection for our customers.

Sports Data Platform team is responsible for ingesting sports metadata such as stats, scores, and imagery from various sources, processing, and delivering it to internal clients.

This role will manage cross-functional projects in Customer Outreach, Partner Integrations, and Sports Data Platform areas.
